title: Fair Text-to-Image Diffusion via Fair Mapping

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using 'Diffusion Bias', which calculates the probability distribution of generated male and female images from neutral occupation and emotion prompts, and 'Language Bias', which measures the Euclidean distance between text embeddings of neutral prompts and gender-specific prompts.

Evaluated using 'Diffusion Bias' by measuring the statistical distribution of generated images across different racial groups (Black, Asian, White, Indian) given neutral occupation and emotion prompts, as well as 'Language Bias' measuring the semantic similarity distances in text embeddings.
